item.title: Natsukage
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sakuraneko
  • 発売日: 2002-10-25
  • スコア: 6.14/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: なつかげ
  • 英語名: Natsukage

あらすじ

Left to take care of the house and his little sister when his parents go overseas for work, the protagonist Asaka Hayato, decides to take his sister on a much needed vacation to a quiet resort town to escape the summer heat. Their friends, sensing danger, plan to join them on their trip. The sibling vacation becomes a five person one when their childhood friends -two sisters, and one bad influence- tag along.

あらすじ

Demons are actually real. They can take human form and infiltrate human society.

Main character studies at a mission-based school in Yokohama that’s rumored to contain hand of a legendary demon in its basement. There are various forces trying to revive the demon. Can protagonist prevent that?
